task.title: See the events of a person
task.shortdesc: List what happened in a person's life, such as birth, baptism and death, and open any one.

prereq.p: Open a person first. shows how.

stepresult.p: A list opens, with a line at the head that says what it holds. Each event has a line with its name, then its date and its place. For Branwell Brontë, the first line says Birth, 1817, and Thornton, near Bradford, Yorkshire.

step.cmd: Choose an event to open it.

stepresult.p: A page with the heading opens. It shows the type, the date, the place and a description. A column named holds the rest, such as the age at the event and the cause. A chip that starts with counts the sources of the event.

step.cmd: Choose to go back to the list.

result.p: The list is in order of date. Branwell's birth in 1817 comes before his baptism on 23 July 1817.
To add an event, choose under the list. shows how.
